scheme_name: NHSRC – National Health Systems Resource Centre Tech Grants
overview: The National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is a premier Think Tank for the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), established in 2007, mandated to assist in policy and strategy development, provision and mobilization of technical assistance to states, and capacity building for the Ministry of Health. It operates as an apex body under the National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) to improve health outcomes through governance reform, health systems innovations, and improved information sharing. NHSRC supports various health initiatives including the FC-XV Health Grants through Local Governments, which involves financial allocations for health sector development.
objectives: Assist in policy and strategy development for the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Mobilize technical assistance to states for health system strengthening
Build capacity for the Ministry of Health at central and state levels
Improve health outcomes through governance reform and health systems innovations
Facilitate improved information sharing among stakeholders at national, state, district, and sub-district levels
Support implementation of health financing initiatives such as FC-XV Health Grants
Strengthen human resource systems in states and Union Territories
Promote evidence-based policy research and health systems strengthening
eligibility: States and Union Territories are eligible to receive FC-XV Health Grants through Local Governments based on technical and operational guidelines issued by the Department of Expenditure (DoE) for the period 2021-22 to 2025-26, with proposals requiring approval from the National Committee under FC-XV Health Grants.
benefits: Financial support for health sector strengthening at the local government level, technical guidance for grant utilization, capacity building for effective implementation, and alignment with national health priorities under the Fifteenth Finance Commission (XV-FC) health sector grants.
financial_support: The FC-XV Health Grants through Local Governments provide financial allocations to states for health sector development as per the Fifteenth Finance Commission recommendations, with guidelines issued by the Department of Expenditure for the period 2021-22 to 2025-26, and funds released upon approval by the National Committee under FC-XV Health Grants.
application_process: 1. States submit proposals for FC-XV Health Grants through Local Governments to the National Health Systems Resource Centre. 2. Proposals are reviewed by the National Committee under FC-XV Health Grants chaired by the Secretary, Health and Family Welfare. 3. Approved proposals are forwarded to the Department of Expenditure for fund release. 4. Funds are released to states upon receipt of approval letters and compliance with technical and operational guidelines. 5. States utilize funds for approved health sector activities and submit utilization reports.
required_documents: Technical and operational guidelines compliance certificate
Utilization certificates for previous grants (if applicable)
Approval letter from the National Committee under FC-XV Health Grants
deadlines: Based on Fifteenth Finance Commission award period (2021-22 to 2025-26); specific submission windows communicated via official circulars
contact_details: Email: Not explicitly stated in evidence; Contact via NHSRC website: https://nhsrcindia.org
caveats: Funds are subject to availability and approval by the National Committee under FC-XV Health Grants
Utilization must comply with technical and operational guidelines issued by the Department of Expenditure
Grants are for the period 2021-22 to 2025-26 as per Fifteenth Finance Commission award
States must submit proposals through official channels; direct applications by entities not permitted
